selection_invariant: Every planned batch retains all164 workspace packages and codex-v8-poc/sandbox. Only Cargo target selectors vary; do not switch to -p package batches or --exclude. Target selection can still alter unused dev-target participation, so compare initial build diagnostics against existing fingerprint graph rather than claim zero recompilation.

libraries.timing: Run after the existing-cli and existing-exec-server batches have passed and their disposable test executables have been archived/verified/reclaimed. Keep runtime failure binaries.

For the118 others, allow roughly3–5GiB output plus a large temporary link; this is a planning range, not a measured compile forecast. Current low single-digit GiB reserve is not proven sufficient. libraries.condition: Do not claim whole-workspace coverage from this lib gate; integrations and binary tests are separate ledger entries.

batches.note: Seven package instances share this name. Must execute and record every instance, including core/app-server/exec; nextest runtime filters would not reduce the build footprint.

artifact_lifecycle: Produce binaries metadata only through actual cargo nextest list with the exact batch selectors; never fabricate or merge hand-authored metadata. A list command may compile this batch.

Run tests through just test, retaining exact stdout/stderr, JUnit, command, source revision/diff identity, environment, and official binary metadata. Each package/binary result must be recorded; no-tests warnings mean zero cases and must not be counted as a behavioral pass.

Only after a batch completes and its test executables are no longer running, select completed generated test executables by official binary metadata and Cargo test fingerprints; require nlink1 and no production/acceptance identity.

For passing generated tests, if space is needed, tar+zstd archive with modes/paths, verify decompressed bytes/SHA256/length, retain manifest and exact reproduction command, then unlink only these generated executable files. Preserve rlibs, shared libraries, production/helper binaries, .d files, fingerprints and all source/proof.
Keep failing test binaries available for diagnosis unless regenerated with a separately recorded debug build; do not archive away unresolved failure reproductions.
Do not delete selected executable outputs between list and run or during nextest execution; reuse metadata refers to their exact existing paths.
A later batch with different target names should not request already archived executables. Never rerun one all-workspace command that would rebuild every archived output simultaneously.
scope_limits: Counts are source-derived target discovery pending Cargo metadata confirmation, not actual runtime test-case counts.
Doctests, ignored tests and other-platform tests are separate. voice-host installed_client is explicitly test=false and requires its explicit standalone gate.

Static symbols were stripped only from84 unaccepted attempt2/4 test binaries with documented first-file caveat; native symbolic backtrace detail is reduced. Runtime sections of83 were verified unchanged.
First all-name batch may be large because seven crates share that test target name; avoid package narrowing as a silent feature graph change.
Nextest filtersets/--partition reduce runtime selection only: source compute_binary_list constructs Cargo artifacts before build_test_list applies filters.
